words.definition: n. 游轮度假，航游 vi. 巡航；平稳慢行

examples.en: The couple went on a cruise around the Mediterranean.
examples.zh: 这对夫妇乘游轮环游地中海。

examples.en: The patrol car cruised slowly along the coastal highway.
examples.zh: 巡逻车沿海滨公路缓缓巡航。

words.usage: 名词 take a cruise 乘船游览；动词 cruise along 沿…巡航、cruise at 以…速度巡航。派生：cruiser n. 巡洋舰；复合词 cruise missile 巡航导弹

synonyms.note: 航行，长途水上旅行，正式

collocations: go on a cruise 乘船游览
a luxury cruise 豪华游轮之旅
words.mnemonic: 谐音「克鲁兹」→ 开车兜风巡航

words.definition: n. 水晶；晶体，结晶 adj. 清澈透明的

examples.en: The mineral forms hexagonal crystals in volcanic rock.
examples.zh: 这种矿物在火山岩中形成六边形晶体。

examples.en: She explained the plan with crystal clarity.
examples.zh: 她把计划讲解得一清二楚。

words.usage: 名词指水晶、结晶，salt crystals 盐晶体；形容词义「清澈透明」，习语 crystal clear 一清二楚。派生：crystallize v. 使结晶，使具体化

confusables.note: 硬壳，地壳；stl 与 st 之差

words.mnemonic: cry（哭）+stal → 泪珠凝成水晶

words.definition: vi. 发嗡嗡声；充满兴奋的谈论 n. 嗡嗡声；兴奋，热议

examples.en: Bees buzzed around the lavender in the garden.
examples.zh: 蜜蜂在花园的薰衣草周围嗡嗡飞舞。

examples.en: The office was buzzing with rumors of a merger.
examples.zh: 办公室里到处都在谈论并购的传闻，嘈杂不已。

words.usage: 象声词，指嗡嗡声；引申「充满热议」buzz with excitement；口语 give sb a buzz 打电话。派生：buzzer n. 蜂鸣器；buzzword n. 流行术语

confusables.note: 模糊的；zz 与 zzy 之差

synonyms.note: 低沉连续的嗡鸣，如冰箱

collocations: buzz with excitement 充满兴奋
create a buzz 引发热议
give sb a buzz 给某人打电话
words.mnemonic: 谐音「巴士」→ 电动巴士嗡嗡响

words.definition: n. 学费（尤美）；教学，讲授

examples.en: Rising tuition has forced many students to take out loans.
examples.zh: 不断上涨的学费迫使许多学生去贷款。

examples.en: He received private tuition in mathematics before the exam.
examples.zh: 考前他接受了数学一对一辅导。

words.usage: 英式多指「教学、讲授」，美式常直接指「学费」；pay tuition 付学费、under sb's tuition 在某人指导下。派生：tutor n. 家庭教师
words.mnemonic: tutor（导师）的名词 → 导师收的教学费

words.definition: vt. 给…染色 n. 染料

examples.en: She dyed her hair blonde before the graduation ceremony.
examples.zh: 毕业典礼前她把头发染成了金色。

examples.en: The fabric is soaked in natural dye extracted from indigo.
examples.zh: 这种布料浸在从靛蓝中提取的天然染料里。

words.usage: 及物，dye sth blue 把…染成蓝色；现在分词 dyeing 勿与 dying（垂死）混淆；名词 hair dye 染发剂。派生：dyestuff n. 染料

synonyms.note: 染色，多指难以去除的着色

words.mnemonic: 谐音「带」→ 布带进染缸染色

words.definition: vt. 等候，等待；即将降临于

examples.en: A warm welcome awaits you at the village inn.
examples.zh: 村庄客栈静候你的光临。

examples.en: The committee is still awaiting the auditors' report.
examples.zh: 委员会仍在等待审计员的报告。

words.usage: 及物，比 wait for 正式，直接接宾语且不接不定式：await approval 等待批复；sth awaits sb 某事即将降临。无派生，可视为 wait for 的及物版
words.mnemonic: a+wait → 把 wait 变及物 → 等候

words.definition: adj. 繁荣的，兴旺的；成功的，富足的

examples.en: The coastal city grew prosperous through trade with its neighbors.
examples.zh: 这座沿海城市通过与邻邦贸易而繁荣起来。

examples.en: He runs a prosperous business selling medical equipment.
examples.zh: 他经营着一家生意兴隆的医疗器械公司。

words.usage: 多修饰经济与事业：a prosperous economy 兴旺的经济；比 rich 客观，指整体昌盛而非巨富。派生：prosper v. 兴旺；prosperity n. 繁荣

confusables.note: 不稳定的；p 开头 -ous 结尾

synonyms.note: 蒸蒸日上，强调增长势头

collocations: a prosperous economy 繁荣的经济
a prosperous business 兴旺的生意
words.mnemonic: prosper（繁荣）+ous → 一片繁茂的

words.definition: n. 繁荣，昌盛；成功富足

examples.en: The policy brought unprecedented prosperity to the region.
examples.zh: 该政策给该地区带来了空前的繁荣。

examples.en: Economic prosperity depends on political stability.
examples.zh: 经济繁荣有赖于政治稳定。

words.usage: 不可数名词，常搭 economic prosperity 经济繁荣；动词 bring/restore prosperity 带来、重振繁荣。派生：prosper v. 兴旺；prosperous adj. 繁荣的
words.mnemonic: prosper 的名词 → 兴旺发达的局面

words.definition: vi. 兴旺，繁荣；成功 vt. 使兴旺

examples.en: After a slow start, the restaurant prospered.
examples.zh: 起步缓慢之后，这家餐馆兴旺了起来。

examples.en: The region prospered from the new trade route.
examples.zh: 该地区因新商路而繁荣。

words.usage: 多作不及物，主语常为事业、地区：business prospers 生意兴隆；prosper from sth 靠…发达。派生：prosperity n. 繁荣；prosperous adj. 兴旺的
collocations: prosper and grow 蓬勃发展
words.mnemonic: pro（向前）+sper（希望）→ 前程有望 → 兴旺

words.definition: adj. 粗糙的，简陋的；粗俗的；未加工的 n. 原油

examples.en: The villagers still rely on crude tools made of stone.
examples.zh: 村民们仍依赖粗陋的石器工具。

examples.en: Crude prices surged after the supply cut.
examples.zh: 减产之后原油价格飙升。

words.usage: 形容词两义：简陋的 a crude shelter、粗俗的 a crude joke；名词 crude 即原油，财经高频。派生：crudely adv. 粗糙地；crudeness n. 粗糙
collocations: a crude joke 粗俗的玩笑
a crude method 简陋的方法
words.mnemonic: c+rude（粗鲁）→ 粗鲁的、粗糙的

words.definition: n. 岛，小岛（多用于地名与诗歌）

examples.en: The mist lifted to reveal a green isle off the coast.
examples.zh: 雾气散去，露出近海一座苍翠的小岛。

examples.en: The British Isles enjoy a mild maritime climate.
examples.zh: 不列颠群岛属温和的海洋性气候。

words.usage: 多用于专名 the British Isles、the Isle of Man；文学化小岛，口语用 island；注意 s 不发音。派生：islet n. 小岛；islander n. 岛民
collocations: the British Isles 不列颠群岛
the Isle of Man 马恩岛
words.mnemonic: 与 island 同源，s 哑音 → 岛

words.definition: n. 迷信，迷信观念（行为）

examples.en: According to local superstition, the bridge must not be crossed at night.
examples.zh: 按当地迷信的说法，夜里不得过那座桥。

examples.en: Science education helps people shake off outdated superstitions.
examples.zh: 科学教育帮助人们摆脱过时的迷信。

words.usage: 不可数指迷信总体，可数指具体说法；believe in superstition 信迷信、root out 破除迷信。派生：superstitious adj. 迷信的
collocations: root out superstition 破除迷信
a widespread superstition 流传甚广的迷信
words.mnemonic: super（超）+stit（站）→ 心里立着超自然 → 迷信

words.definition: n. 抗议，反对 v. 抗议；坚称，申辩

examples.en: Thousands of workers staged a protest against the layoffs.
examples.zh: 数千名工人举行抗议反对裁员。

examples.en: Residents protested at the plan to close the hospital.
examples.zh: 居民抗议关闭医院的计划。

words.usage: 名词 ˈprotest、动词 prəˈtest，重音区分词性；protest against sth 抗议某事；in protest 以示抗议。派生：protester n. 抗议者；protestation n. 声明

confusables.note: 保护；tec 与 tes 一字差
竞争；同为名动重音移动

collocations: stage a protest 举行抗议
protest against sth 抗议某事
words.mnemonic: pro（向前）+test（考试）→ 冲到考场前抗议

words.definition: n. 提供，供给；预先准备；条款；（复）给养

examples.en: The constitution makes provision for freedom of speech.
examples.zh: 宪法为言论自由作了规定。

examples.en: The provision of clean water remains a challenge in remote areas.
examples.zh: 在偏远地区提供清洁用水仍是一大难题。

words.usage: 多义名词：the provision of services 服务提供；make provision for 预作准备；复数 provisions 给养。派生：provide v. 提供
collocations: make provision for 为…作准备
the provision of services 服务提供
words.mnemonic: provide 的名词 → 供出的是给养和条款

words.definition: adj. 自动的；不假思索的，无意识的 n. 自动挡汽车

examples.en: The automatic doors close when they detect movement.
examples.zh: 自动门检测到动静就会关闭。

examples.en: Over the years, checking email has become automatic.
examples.zh: 多年来查邮件已成了不假思索的习惯。

words.usage: 形容词两义：自动的 an automatic system、不假思索的 an automatic reaction；名词口语指自动挡。派生：automate v. 使自动化；automatically adv. 自动地
collocations: an automatic reaction 本能反应
words.mnemonic: auto（自己）+matic → 自己动的 → 自动的

words.definition: n. 王朝，朝代；世袭权势家族

examples.en: The palace was built during the Ming Dynasty.
examples.zh: 这座宫殿建于明代。

examples.en: The Kennedy family is regarded as a political dynasty in America.
examples.zh: 肯尼迪家族被视为美国的政治王朝。

words.usage: 可数名词，the Tang Dynasty 唐朝；引申指世袭权势家族 a political dynasty 政治世家。派生：dynastic adj. 王朝的，世袭的
collocations: a political dynasty 政治世家
overthrow a dynasty 推翻王朝
words.mnemonic: dynast（君主）+y → 君主家代代相传 → 王朝

words.definition: vt. 激怒，使烦躁；使（身体）不适，刺激

examples.en: His constant joking irritated the serious professor.
examples.zh: 他不停开玩笑惹恼了严肃的教授。

examples.en: The smoke irritated her eyes and throat.
examples.zh: 烟雾刺激得她眼睛和喉咙不适。

words.usage: 心理义 be irritated by sth 对…恼火；生理义 irritate the skin 刺激皮肤，医学高频。派生：irritation n. 恼怒，刺激；irritable adj. 易怒的

confusables.note: 灌溉；g 与 t 一字之差

collocations: irritate the skin 刺激皮肤
be irritated by sth 被某事激怒
an irritating habit 惹人烦的习惯
words.mnemonic: ir（入）+rit（摩擦）→ 摩入心头 → 使烦躁

words.definition: n. 混乱，动荡，骚动

examples.en: The country was in political turmoil after the sudden resignation.
examples.zh: 突然辞职之后，该国陷入政治动荡。

examples.en: Her emotions were in turmoil as the exam approached.
examples.zh: 考试临近，她心乱如麻。

words.usage: 不可数名词，be in (a state of) turmoil 陷入混乱；political/economic turmoil 政治、经济动荡。无常用派生，近义联想 chaos

synonyms.note: 混乱，程度最强，完全无序

collocations: in a state of turmoil 处于混乱状态
throw sth into turmoil 使陷入混乱
words.mnemonic: 谐音「太毛乱」→ 乱成一团 → 动荡

words.definition: n. 橡胶；橡皮擦；胶鞋（复）

examples.en: The tires are made of synthetic rubber.
examples.zh: 这些轮胎由合成橡胶制成。

examples.en: May I borrow your rubber to erase this line?
examples.zh: 能借你的橡皮擦掉这行字吗？

words.usage: 本义橡胶，synthetic rubber 合成橡胶；英式 a rubber 指橡皮擦，美式说 eraser；习语 rubber stamp 图章式批准。派生：rubbery adj. 橡胶似的

confusables.note: 强盗；双 b 且元音不同

words.mnemonic: rub（擦）+b+er → 用来擦的东西 → 橡皮

words.definition: n. 象牙；象牙色，乳白色 adj. 象牙制的；乳白的

examples.en: The trade in ivory has been banned to protect elephants.
examples.zh: 为保护大象，象牙贸易已被禁止。

examples.en: She wore an ivory silk dress at the ceremony.
examples.zh: 典礼上她穿着一条象牙白真丝裙。

words.usage: 不可数指象牙，the ivory trade 象牙贸易；习语 ivory tower 象牙塔；形容词指乳白色。派生：ivory-white adj. 象牙白的

confusables.note: 反讽；v 与 n 之差

collocations: the ivory trade 象牙贸易
an ivory gown 象牙白礼服
words.mnemonic: 谐音「爱我泪」→ 拔我牙我流泪 → 象牙
